title: Sign in to the portal
summary: The direct sign-in at key.plrs.im when no app is asking: 'Sign in to Polaris Key', identifier first (email, Continue), the logo-only provider row (Apple, Google, Steam), a passkey ghost button and the quiet links, on the static star field with no art beside the card.
compare: Identifier first, then the logo-only provider row and the passkey button; no 'or' rule on the portal-direct card (the app card keeps its own).
No app header, no product art beside or above the card (B12; the optional requesting-product cover is PX-33, only for app sign-in ≥1180 and only if the owner asks).
Continue is ink (B2); provider buttons use only the providers' allowed fills (white with a 3:1 edge in light), never a tint.
Inputs are at least 16px on touch so phones don't zoom (portal-08); the star field stays static.
Phone: the card is edge to edge; Help, Privacy, Terms under it.
